description: MainActivity.kt is an Android activity class that manages UI elements, permission checks, and SSH testing functionalities within an Android app for handling notifications and SSH interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing notification listener permissions, SSH testing, and UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets UI layout, binds event handlers, and UI data flows.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates UI when activity resumes, particularly permission status.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels coroutines scope when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: bindUi
methods.description: Sets up data flow collection to update UI with last notification results and SSH config.

methods.name: refreshPermissionUi
methods.description: Updates UI indicators and action buttons based on notification access permissions.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener service is enabled.

methods.name: needsPostNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Checks if POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission is needed on Android Tiramisu and above.

methods.name: openNotificationAccessSettings
methods.description: Opens the notification access system settings page.

methods.name: requestPostNotificationsIfNeededLegacy
methods.description: Requests POST_NOTIFICATIONS permission if required (Android Tiramisu+).

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission requests and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: openSettingsActivity
methods.description: Attempts to start SettingsActivity; falls back to app details if not available.

methods.name: openAppSelectionActivity
methods.description: Attempts to start AppSelectionActivity; falls back to app details if not available.

methods.name: openAppDetails
methods.description: Opens app details page in system settings.

methods.name: launchTestSsh
methods.description: Performs an SSH command test, using real or fake SSH client based on stored credentials.
